dry_run_contract.method: Evaluate every trigger with read-only commands and existing immutable receipts; execute rollback only when the trigger is present.

receipts.assertion: Raw verify is full with status ok and no errors; the immutable repair receipt records zero digest changes.
receipts.rollback_action: Disable the processed projection reconciler before further mutation; after the ingest lock is free, refresh ingest-drain from the last known-good pushed commit while preserving Raw, quarantine, and receipts.

receipts.assertion: Projection status is full and total equals valid with missing and invalid both zero; immutable repair duplicate and idempotence counters remain zero.
receipts.rollback_action: Disable the processed projection reconciler, stop further projection mutation, and restore only the last known-good reconciler commit; retain Raw, quarantine, and receipt artifacts.

receipts.command: uv run pytest -q tests/test_research_security.py tests/test_web_provider.py tests/test_utility_modules.py tests/test_server_check.py tests/test_server_validation.py
receipts.assertion: Public HTTP, DNS rebinding, and proxy bypass are rejected before request; default or one-sided Raw preview, path leak, and credential leak remain zero.
receipts.rollback_action: Halt deployment, force remote egress disabled and MCP metadata-only dual-opt-in, retain refusal logs, and never relax the HTTPS, loopback, or 0600 boundary.

receipts.live_check_command: uv run chronovisor status --json && uv run chronovisor health --json
receipts.assertion: After at least 24 hours and 100 eligible prompts per active host, deadline pass rate is at least 0.99, outer timeout rate is below 0.01, host-wrapper timeout is zero, and success p95/p99 are at most 3000/3400 ms.

before.host_wrapper_timeout_observability: not represented in pre-deploy structured records

receipts.rollback_action: Keep the Plan running and do not loosen thresholds. If the qualified post-deploy cohort fails, run the existing Recall policy rollback, verify status and health, and revert only the implicated availability commit.

receipts.assertion: Current authority, active failure, and liveness age agree across runtime, API, and DOM; stale ingest or current blocked authority stays visible as alert rather than being masked.
receipts.rollback_action: Revert only the Dashboard health overlay or runtime-identity consumer commit, push before refreshing Dashboard and LAN, and preserve the backend failure state.

receipts.live_check_command: uv run pytest -q tests/test_research_security.py tests/test_web_provider.py tests/test_server_check.py tests/test_server_validation.py
receipts.assertion: Credential egress and credential leak counts are zero, and insecure HTTP, redirect, proxy, and rebinding paths are rejected before a request.
receipts.rollback_action: Immediately disable remote egress and the affected remote worker, retain refusal and audit logs, and never roll back to public HTTP or disabled TLS verification.

receipts.live_check_command: uv run ruff check --no-cache src scripts tests && uv run mypy && uv run lint-imports --no-cache
receipts.assertion: Two isolated full suites have zero failures or errors; Ruff, mypy, import-linter, architecture, and required quality, Python 3.14, and security jobs are green.
receipts.rollback_action: Revert the failing candidate commit, push before restart, refresh only affected services, then rerun isolated full, static, and required CI gates.

receipts.live_check_command: uv run chronovisor health --json && uv run chronovisor status --json
receipts.assertion: The pushed commit, expected runtime commit, and required service archive commits agree; health runtime drift is false and no old GitHub-backed worker remains.
receipts.rollback_action: Refresh all affected managed services from the last known-good pushed commit, then rerun runtime identity, health, status, socket readiness, archive equality, and DOM checks.
